reviews.review: Very fun game the PvE content is good, PvP can be a bit bland cause its 3rd person but still fun. Snap hooking everywhere is lots of fun

If the game gives a startup message about BIOS update due to ♥♥♥♥♥♥ Intel CPU's, definitely do it.

Aside from that...
Graphics, sound, physics, environment are all good.  Fighting clankers is cool for awhile.  The game doesn't have a compelling story though.  I wasn't into the PvP, so at this point (40h) it feels like there's not much left to do except boring quests and pointless loot collection for pointless upgrades.  It was a good ride though until now.

I like that the aggression based matchmaking isn't a guaranteed to keep pvp out of your matches. It makes friendly interactions meaningful and impactful. I don't like that if I want to play with a friend who is also a pacifist we get PVP 8 out of 9 matches.

I really wanted to get all the skill points for my third expedition but the change to force players to do damage in just 2 weeks rather than collecting value over the course of months has made this impossible. I don't have the resources to do damage. Trying to get help from a friend results in backwards progress because death from other players and a loss of gear is nearly guaranteed.

Embark.. I have 2 raider downs with over 400 hours of playtime. I'm ok with waiting an extra 10 minutes in matchmaking so I'm not in lobbies with people who have thousands of raider downs. I like your game. I just wish I could play it with friends.
